answer: Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
